info.title: Personal Finance Manager API
info.description: Allocate first. Spend second. Amounts are decimal strings in the account currency (INR by default). Errors are { statusCode, code, message, fields?, details? }.

balance.description: Signed ledger balance; negative on a credit card means money owed

accountMask.description: Last 2–4 digits only. Never send a full account or card number.

openingBalance.description: Current balance when you start tracking. For credit cards, enter the amount you currently owe.

openingDate.description: When the account was opened at the bank (informational).

trackingStartDate.description: The date your opening balance applies from. Transactions before this date can only be added as historical statement imports. Defaults to today.

isLiquid.description: Override whether this counts as spendable money (defaults by type).

actualBalance.description: The balance your bank or wallet shows right now. For credit cards, the amount owed.

budget.description: Category budget this expense counts against

type.description: Use transfer for moving money between your own accounts, including paying a credit card bill.

accountId.description: Account the money comes from (expense/transfer) or goes into (income).

sourceName.description: Income source, e.g. employer or client

externalReference.description: Bank/UPI reference number. Used to prevent counting the same transaction twice.

historical.description: Explicit historical import: a statement line dated before the account tracking start date. Counted in analytics, never in the balance (the opening balance already includes it). Only for statement_import / account_aggregator sources.

reservationId.description: Pay a reserved commitment with this expense. The reservation is released in the same step, so money is not deducted twice.

acceptReservationDifference.description: Required when the amount differs from the reservation: confirms you reviewed the difference.

version.description: The version you are editing (optimistic locking).

accountId.description: Account the payment will be made from.

intervalCount.description: Every N periods; for custom_days, the number of days.

reserveAmount.description: How much to set aside now. Defaults to the full amount; less = partial reservation.

reservedAmount.description: New amount set aside (0 to target).

transactionId.description: An existing confirmed expense or transfer that paid this commitment.

acceptDifference.description: Confirm you reviewed a difference between the reserved and paid amount.

totalBalance.description: All non-liability accounts, including fixed deposits

savings.description: Total saved across goals (track-only and reserve)

upcomingPayments.description: Up to 10 open reservations, earliest due first

categoryId.description: Leave empty for an overall spending limit.

periodDays.description: Required for custom periods: length in days.

startDate.description: First day of the first period. For monthly budgets, its day-of-month is the reset day. Defaults to the 1st of this month (monthly) or today.

rollover.description: Carry the previous period's unused amount into the next period.

alertThresholds.description: Percent thresholds that trigger an alert (1–100).

accountId.description: Account where this money is kept (optional).

allocationMode.description: track_only (default): progress is tracked, available-to-spend is unchanged. reserve: saved money is set aside and reduces available-to-spend (unless kept in a non-liquid account).

initialAmount.description: Amount already saved for this goal.

allocationMode.description: track_only (default): progress is tracked, available-to-spend is unchanged. reserve: saved money is set aside and reduces available-to-spend (unless kept in a non-liquid account).

transactionId.description: Optional: the confirmed transfer that physically moved this money into (contribution) or out of (withdrawal) the goal's account. Its amount must match.

availableNow.description: Available-to-spend at the end of asOf

idToken.description: Google ID token from Google Sign-In
